description: This file is a test script for Git submodule handling, specifically testing the 'git am' command with submodules, including various setup scenarios and configurations.

methods.name: am
methods.description: A function that creates a patch with 'git format-patch' ignoring submodules, and then applies it with 'git am', allowing testing of submodule handling during patch application.

methods.name: am_3way
methods.description: A variant of the 'am' function that applies the patch with a 3-way merge option.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: A test helper function invoked with 'am' or 'am_3way' to run tests on submodule switching behavior.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes a sequence of Git commands to set up the repository state, apply patches, and verify the correctness of submodule updates against expected results.
